caption:
Desserts from A-Z, the goal : to try to make desserts i have never made before. the key word here is try starting with A for Alfajores.This classic South American treat has melt-in-your-mouth dulce de leche sandwiched between traditional shortbread cookies. for the cookies, we start with a threee ingredient shortbread that comes together in minutes and a cheats tin dulce de leches that is super simple to make! store these in the fridge and you will have a lovely snack for the next 2 weeks if they last that long 

Ingredients: 
-90 grams maida
-75 grams salted butter, softened
-20 grams icing sugar 
-a few drops of vanilla extract, optional
-dulce de leche

Method: 
-mix together the softened butter and icing sugar
-add in the flour and vanilla and mix gently to combine
-roll the dough between two parchment paper sheets to 1/4inch thickness and place the sheet in the freezer for 10 minutes to harden
-feel free to use any cookie cutter you have that is under 5 cm, i used this heart cutter i had lying around
-cut the cookies with the cutter and place on a parchment paper lined baking sheet
-bake in a preheated 190degree oven for 10 - 12 minutes ( the longer the bake the crispier the cookie)
-take out of the oven and cool to room tempreture
-fill the cookies with your premade dulce de leche and sandwich together
-store in the fridge. 

HOW TO MAKE DULCE DE LECHE
-place your condensed milk can in a pot of water making sure to keep the tin submerged in water fully and cook for 3-3.5 hours. 
-remove the can and allow to cool before you open the can.
